description: This file declares the StateTransitionHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class manages state transition requests, providing methods for initialization, termination, and adding requests. It also implements the singleton pattern with a static getInstance method and a private constructor.

classes.description: A singleton class responsible for handling state transition requests within the plugin framework.
